title: Wu-Tang Clan inducted into the Rock Hall by Chris Rock
summary: The New York rap group performed a medley of their hits backed by a full jazz big band.
body:
Wu-Tang Clan were inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame on Saturday 14 November by the comedian Chris Rock.

The New York group then performed a medley that included "C.R.E.A.M." and "Shimmy Shimmy Ya", the hit by their late member Ol' Dirty Bastard, backed by a full jazz big band.

Part of a varied class

The group were inducted alongside Phil Collins, Oasis, Iron Maiden, Sade, Billy Idol, Luther Vandross and Joy Division/New Order. The record producer Rick Rubin, who received an award for musical excellence, was honoured by the Red Hot Chili Peppers, who performed "Give It Away" wearing long fake white beards.

Sources: Associated Press, Billboard.
